decision.summary: Two multi-sample offsets are evident in the allowed context [570,655]: one at 570–572 (N/E/U drop), another at 577–579 (N/E/U shift), both lacking confirmed opposing returns. The screened region (605–620) contains a data gap at 608 and no unambiguous return after any candidate onset; thus no temporary offset can be confirmed. All candidate intervals remain uncertain due to incomplete return observation.
